question: What divine embodiment is invoked by the name Śrī Jaganmaṅgala?
premises: The invoked form bears the name Śrī Jaganmaṅgala
This form is described as great
This form embodies a stream of vidyās
inference: The invocation addresses the embodiment of the stream of great vidyās named Śrī Jaganmaṅgala
plain_english: The embodiment of the stream of great vidyās, named Śrī Jaganmaṅgala.
